extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: high-speed train power car with long soft nose, 20.0 m long, 2.9 m wide, 4.1 m high with lowered pantograph, standard gauge 1435 mm
extras.notes: front (nose) faces -Y, origin on the rail top (wheel contact plane); rear centre coupler axis 1.05 m above rail top (Cozy Trains kit standard), the front coupler sits hidden behind the nose; own cozy design, not a copy of any real train; single-arm pantograph modelled lowered; bogies with wheelsets are part of the mesh (no moving parts); emissive lights, opaque tinted windows, no interior, no lettering

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
